text: ★ IDENTIFIED: Neem. Feathery leaves, bitter smell. Medicine, not food — small amounts only. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.

Mostly wing. Crunchy. Tastes like dust and regret. It's dead. The carcass is there on the ground — search the body if you want the meat. But you don't know this flesh. Clean it, test it cautiously, or ask someone who knows. And don't leave it long: meat rots where it lies.
